precepts.text: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people, and hath raised up an horn of salvation for us: that horn of salvation is Christ. As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets: that we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us. You want to know the answer? Christ is coming back to save us from the hand of all that hate us. Your enemies are not supposed to love you; the problem is you think you have no enemies. To perform the mercy promised to our fathers: the promise is that the kingdom is ours.
precepts.point: The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy. Brothers, our judgment is almost ended. We have a short time here; so why are you bugging out?

note.label: Why They Hated US: Walking in the Footsteps of the Persecuted

precepts.why:
Zephaniah says, “The Lord hath taken away thy judgments, he hath cast out thine enemy”. Luke shows how he does it: “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people, And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”. That horn of salvation is Christ, the black Messiah.

“As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began: That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us”. Our people ask, what did we do to you? Why do you hate us so much? You want to know the answer? Christ is coming back to save you from the hand of all that hate you.

Why are you worried that your enemies hate you? Your enemies are not supposed to love you; they were created to hate you. The problem is you think you have no enemies. It is a good thing they hate us, and they should continue: they hate us when we are in our righteousness, not when we are in the streets. So don't worry about those that hate you. Rejoice.

“To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant”. The mercy promised to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob is that the kingdom is ours. That is why Zephaniah says, “Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart”. Rejoice in the law, rejoice on the Sabbath, rejoice to be among the brothers and sisters. Our judgment is almost ended, and we have a short time here, so why are you bugging out? “The king of Israel, even the Lord, is in the midst of thee: thou shalt not see evil any more.”

precepts.text: The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God.
precepts.point: I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride: the pastors and the parties rejoice in us going against God's commandments.

note.label: Recovering the Remnant: Worldwide Blitz

precepts.why:
Zephaniah says, “for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride”. Who rejoices in our pride? Sirach proves what pride is: “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God”.

Pride is departing from God, going against his commandments; it is our sin. So those that rejoice in our pride are the ones that rejoice in us going against God's commandments: the pastors, the Christians, the churches, the Democrats and the Republicans. They rejoice in us not keeping God's commandments. The Lord says, I am going to take them out of you, take them away from you, “and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain”, the land of Israel.

What he leaves is “an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of the Lord.” The elect beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, the daughter of his dispersed, a large portion of them on the continent of Africa, are afflicted and very poor, as we saw going throughout Africa keeping Passover and the feast of unleavened bread. They must be taught to trust in the name of the Lord.

“The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies”, because they are being taught the commandments, and that is what we go out there for. No, Jesus is not white; no, he was not born December 25th; no, we are not to pray to Mary or to the ancestors. Sin has always been the problem, and breaking God's commandments is a sign of unbelief. When the ones who rejoice in our departing from God are taken away, the remnant shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

precepts.text: I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
precepts.point: Israel shall be named priests of the Lord, receive double for its shame, and its seed shall be known among the Gentiles.

note.label: Jubilee: The Year To Be Set Free

precepts.why:
When the captives are set free, “ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord”, “For your shame ye shall have double”, and “their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.” No matter where we go on this planet they are going to know our children by name. Today you want to talk to your boss and he turns his back to you; on that day they are going to beg for your attention.

Zephaniah is the precept to that: “Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee.” He is going to undo all the nations that afflict us. “and I will save her that halteth”: we are the ones that halt, because we are captive. “and gather her that was driven out.”

“and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.” We get that fame and that glory, and our children are going to get it too. Everybody is going to acknowledge who we are. “At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.”

That is the liberty proclaimed to the captives in Isaiah 61: not only freed, but honoured in the very lands that shamed us.

precepts.text: Wait ye upon me until the day that I rise up to the prey, for my determination is to gather the nations and assemble the kingdoms to pour upon them mine indignation, and all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy. Then, after that, will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord to serve him with one consent. The pure language comes after God destroys the nations and their armies.
precepts.point: Christ says he will write upon him the name of his God, and the name of the city of his God, and his own new name. So what is the argument about? The name is given, not worked out in the street.

note.label: The Fallacy of Black Christians

precepts.text: I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes; Israel will be famous again.
precepts.point: Take pride in this: we are the descendants of the most famous men on the face of the earth. Our forefathers are mentioned in every single nation, and everybody wants to lay claim to them and to our book. That is why all nations hate us, and we will be famous again: the Most High will get Israel praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame, when he turns back our captivity before our eyes. Remember, Jerusalem is a people before it is a place.

note.label: Joshua 12: The Thirty and One Kings

precepts.why:
We will be famous again. “In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear thou not: and to Zion, Let not thine hands be slack. The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over thee with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over thee with singing.” Remember, Jerusalem is a people before it is a place.

“Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame. At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, saith the Lord.”

The Most High will get Israel praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame, when he turns back our captivity before our eyes. We are the descendants of the most famous men on the face of the earth, the men who took thirty and one kings, and we will be a name and a praise among all people of the earth again.

note.label: Zechariah 8: I Will Return Unto Zion and Dwell in the Midst of Jerusalem

precepts.why:
The bible has its own definition for the words written in it. Zion is named plainly, so there is no need to guess who he is jealous over and who he returns to. “Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Israel; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.”

The daughter of Zion is Israel. He was jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and he is returned unto Zion to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: that is Israel he is jealous over and Israel he returns to.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 14 Part 2

precepts.why:
“For then will I turn to the people a pure language”: the operative word is pure. The Hebrew Israelite camps always go to Esau’s Strong’s Concordance and Ben Yehuda’s Hebrew dictionary; it is not pure, the Bible says it is not pure. And the groups that don’t believe in Christ go to the Hebrew to argue that he never existed and there was no J in Hebrew, to get you confused.

“That they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: that is not today. Google the names of God and you will find over ten, everybody arguing. It sounds nice, but it ain’t pure, because the Bible says it ain’t pure.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 22

precepts.why: “For my determination is to gather the nations.” “For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent”: for then, after he destroys the armies of the nations. That means right now everyone is not calling on the Lord with one consent. We are not arguing with other camps over how to pronounce the name; to prove the pronunciation you would have to go back in time and hear the Hebrew, so everything we have now is by faith. Keep the commandments.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 3 A Message to The 7 Churches

precepts.why:
I will write upon him the name of my God. “Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger:” So the Lord is going to gather the nations to bring destruction on them. That includes America, that includes Russia, China, Japan, Europe, Britain, all of them. “for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.”

“For then will I turn to the people a pure language,” Because when that happens, when he does that, then he is going to change our language. We are not going to be speaking English any more, Spanish no more, Creole no more, all these little funky languages we have. God said, I'm going to change it, the same way he did in the beginning, Genesis 11: he is going to undo what he did in Genesis 11. He is going to give us that pure language again. Some of you Israelite camps really believe, in your deluded mind, that you have the pure language. You don't even speak Hebrew. Ask one of them, how do you say hand me the water bottle? We learned key words only; it is like in Spanish, I know certain key words, especially the curse words, but I don't speak Spanish fluently. Likewise you all claim to know Hebrew; you don't speak it, and that Hebrew you speak ain't the pure language, because if it was there would be no need for the Lord to do this.

“that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.” When I was in Nigeria there was a brother from another Israelite camp, an Igbo, who said, I see your videos and you say the name Christ, you say Jesus, once in a while in your music videos you may say Yahawashi, but we must come on one accord with the name of the Lord. Do you believe the Bible? Oh, definitely. You believe the whole Bible? I believe the whole Bible. So we read this to the brother and his elder: for then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent. My dear Igbo brother, do you believe that? Yes, I do. Then why are you saying I have to learn the name of Yeshua the way you say it? Because it's necessary. That means you don't believe the scripture. You are going to find out a vast majority of these Hebrew Israelite camps don't believe the scriptures, whether it comes to language or to women. Mark my words.
